# Search for each song and find the matching song_id
song_ids = []
for title, artist in songs:
    # Search for the song
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=title, access_token=spotify_token)
    # Find the exact match
    found = False
    for song in results:
        if song['title'] == title:
            # Check if any artist matches
            song_artists = [a['name'] for a in song['artists']]
            # For songs with multiple artists, check if all artists are present
            artist_list = [a.strip() for a in artist.split(',')]
            if all(any(a == sa for sa in song_artists) for a in artist_list):
                song_ids.append(song['song_id'])
                found = True
                break
    if not found:
        print(f"Could not find exact match for: {title} by {artist}")
print(f"Found {len(song_ids)} song IDs")
